name: ButtonGroup
summary: Keep related actions together with shared orientation and attached styling.

useWhen: Presenting two or more related actions as one visual group.
Joining tightly related peer actions on the same object into one attached strip.
avoidWhen: For unrelated actions or a navigation list.
Attaching actions that differ in prominence or consequence, such as Save beside Delete; keep them spaced.
Choosing one or more options with a pressed state; use ToggleButtonGroup.
Moving between controls with the arrow keys; use Toolbar.

obligations: Preserves child action order and keyboard focus order.
Presentation groups require no accessible name; named groups expose group semantics.

behavior: Preserves child action order and keyboard focus order.
Presentation groups require no accessible name; named groups expose group semantics.
horizontal lays the children out in a row and vertical stacks them in a column.
attached removes the gap between the children and rounds only the outer corners of the first and last child.
attached joins only direct Button, IconButton, and ToggleButton children; a Button inside a wrapping element keeps its own rounded corners.
ButtonGroup adds no arrow-key navigation: each child is a separate Tab stop.
disabled sets data-disabled on the group and does not disable its children.
A child is disabled only by its own disabled prop.
accessibility: Preserves child action order and keyboard focus order.
Presentation groups require no accessible name; named groups expose group semantics.
